body.name: Refitted arm-vector procedure and raw scalar diagnostic
body.construction:
Choose \(m\to\infty\) with \(m/n\to0\).  Conditionally on \(O_1,\ldots,O_n\), draw \(B\) uniformly over subsets of \(\{1,\ldots,n\}\) of cardinality \(m\).  For every realized \(B\), refit the joint learner, generalized-inverse scales, clips, preliminary quantiles, endpoint corrections, and densities using only observations indexed by \(B\).  Define
\[
 V_{B,a}(\tau)=\frac m{\widehat H_{a,m,B}}
 \{\widehat q_{a,B}^{\mathrm{bc}}(\tau)-\widehat q_a^{\mathrm{bc}}(\tau)\},
 \qquad
 T_{B,n}(\tau)=\widehat\ell_{1,n}V_{B,1}(\tau)-\widehat\ell_{0,n}V_{B,0}(\tau).
\]
Define
\[
 c_{n,p}(\tau)=\inf\left\{t:\mathbb P_B\{T_{B,n}(\tau)\le t\mid O_1,\ldots,O_n\}\ge p\right\},
\]
\[
 M_{B,n}=\max_{\tau\in\mathcal T}|T_{B,n}(\tau)|,
 \qquad
 c^{\max}_{n,p}=\inf\left\{t:\mathbb P_B\{M_{B,n}\le t\mid O_1,\ldots,O_n\}\ge p\right\},
\]
and
\[
 \mathcal C_n^{\mathrm{sim}}(\tau)=
 \left[\widehat\Delta^{\mathrm{bc}}(\tau)-\frac{\widehat H_n}{n}c^{\max}_{n,1-\alpha},
 \widehat\Delta^{\mathrm{bc}}(\tau)+\frac{\widehat H_n}{n}c^{\max}_{n,1-\alpha}\right].
\]
For comparison only, define the internal raw scalar refit
\[
 T^{\mathrm{raw}}_{B,n}(\tau)
 =\frac m{\max_{a\in\mathcal A}\widehat H_{a,m,B}}
 \left[
 \{\widehat q_{1,B}^{\mathrm{bc}}(\tau)-\widehat q_{0,B}^{\mathrm{bc}}(\tau)\}
 -\{\widehat q_1^{\mathrm{bc}}(\tau)-\widehat q_0^{\mathrm{bc}}(\tau)\}
 \right].
\]
This raw statistic is an internal diagnostic and is not attributed to a published procedure.
inputs: the conditional uniform size-m subset law
